statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted your custom domain to load your funnel instead of showing a "site can't be reached" error.
We removed the old records and added the CNAME records for your domain, and you confirmed that both the main address and the www version now load your funnel.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting the domain.
On the morning after our call, we will check that the certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.
